summary: Gives best practices for using SIP to set up confidential media sessions. The SIP security toolbox has grown over the years but no single place explains how to combine it, and some mechanisms have feature gaps. This best current practice document pulls the guidance together and identifies those gaps.

eli5.summary: Making a private phone call over the Internet can be done with several tools, and it's easy to get it wrong. This document is a how-to guide that says how to use them so nobody else can listen.
